chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.199: Alliances, Misunderstandings, and a Proposed Marriage
chapter_meta_description: After Long Teng's visit, every major faction in Heavenly Emperor City rushes to court Xiao Chen—misinterpreting his connection to the Dragon Clan. Even the Undying Sect offers Yan Qingcheng's hand. A chapter of political irony and shifting power.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch.199: A Flurry of Invitations and a Reluctant Bride
og_description: Xiao Chen becomes the most sought-after man in the city as factions compete for his favor. Yan Qingcheng is pressured into marriage, and the truth behind the courtship is built on layered misunderstandings.
twitter_description: Every faction wants Xiao Chen. Yan Qingcheng refuses to be a pawn. The truth is built on rumors. A turning point in city politics.
